sources.travel_advisory: US State Department Travel Advisories (early 2025 baseline)

field_definitions.hdi: Human Development Index value (0-1). Very High: 0.800+, High: 0.700-0.799, Medium: 0.550-0.699, Low: <0.550
field_definitions.travel_advisory: US State Dept level (1-4). 1=Exercise Normal Precautions, 2=Exercise Increased Caution, 3=Reconsider Travel, 4=Do Not Travel. Territory ratings inherit parent country level.
field_definitions.independence_year: Year of independence/formation. Negative values = BCE.
field_definitions.independence_from: Colonial/imperial power or predecessor state. null for ancient/formation countries.
field_definitions.sovereignty_type: How the country achieved sovereignty. Values: Ancient, Colonial, Post-Soviet, Post-Ottoman, Secession, Reunification, Mandate/Protectorate, Post-Yugoslav, Merger, Settlement, Never Colonized

tooltip_text.hdi: Human Development Index (UNDP) — composite measure of life expectancy, education, and standard of living. Scale: 0 to 1. Very High: 0.800+, High: 0.700-0.799, Medium: 0.550-0.699, Low: below 0.550.
tooltip_text.travel_advisory: US State Department Travel Advisory (1-4). Level 1 = Exercise Normal Precautions. Level 2 = Exercise Increased Caution. Level 3 = Reconsider Travel. Level 4 = Do Not Travel. Territory ratings inherit their parent country advisory level. Levels are point-in-time and can change.
tooltip_text.sovereignty_type: How the country achieved its current sovereignty. Ancient = continuous sovereignty since antiquity. Colonial = independence from a European colonial power. Post-Soviet = emerged from USSR dissolution. Post-Ottoman = emerged from Ottoman Empire collapse. Secession = broke away from a modern state. Reunification = unified from previously divided states. Mandate/Protectorate = League of Nations or UN administered pathway to independence. Post-Yugoslav = emerged from Yugoslavia dissolution. Merger = formed by merging existing states. Settlement = founded by settlers. Never Colonized = maintained independence through the colonial era.
